'''Lathe''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guard for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
Lathe was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CCG" /> who served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a guard and [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] at<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|Desilijic Complex]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In addition to his duties at the complex, he also served as a [[Skiff guard/Legends|skiff guard]] for the Hutt.<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> He longed to leave the world to see what [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had to offer<ref name="CSWE" /> and, at one point, was in the process of leaving.<ref name="CCG" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Jabba ordered that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friends [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that resided in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on Tatooine after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. Lathe traveled on a<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]]<ref name="Skiff">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Bantha-II Cargo Skiff}}</ref> piloted by the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]] to the site while Jabba's prisoners rode on a second skiff.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Lathe was a vile individual who, deep down, loathed the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade.<ref name="CCG" /> He was loyal to Jabba, had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin,<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TVC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Decipher]]'s card of Lathe mistakenly shows an image of [[Nysad/Legends|Nysad]] in Jabba's Palace. [[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]] retconned him as a different Nikto character on the skiff. He was portrayed by an uncredited extra.
